packageRules.description: numpy, Pillow and SciPy shape the SVG: an update can change unpixel's output, and needs the battery check.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Runtime dependency of the engine.** This update can change unpixel's SVG output. If the golden-output check (`tests/test_golden.py`) fails, do not merge until the owner has compared the new output with the old on the image battery (`battery/README.md`) and approved it; then refresh the goldens (README, "Golden outputs") in this PR. `requirements.lock` is not updated by Renovate: regenerate it with `uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt -o requirements.lock` (the lock test fails until then).
